newsitem.title: USA: Substance Abuse shuts West Coast operations.
newsitem.headline: Substance Abuse shuts West Coast operations.

text.p: Substance Abuse Technologies Inc said on Thursday it closed two of its four operating divisions, a move it expects to improve cash flow and allow it to focus on new sales and acquisitions.
The company said in a news release that it closed its alcohol products and biochemical toxicology laboratories divisions, both located in Rancho Cucamonga, Calif.
Substance Abuse also said it drastically reduced the operating budget for its majority-owned subsidiary U.S. Drug Testing Inc.
The company said it will focus on its two remaining divisions, for drug-free workplace consulting and drug and alcohol testing administration.

Substance Abuse on Tuesday had said its auditor's report for fiscal 1997 was subject to a "going concern" qualification due to the company's recurring operating losses, working capital deficiency and a deficiency in stockholders equity at the end of its fiscal year.
